razonamiento: The architecture shows Seera Group's (Al Musafir) platform modernizing from legacy monoliths on EC2 to containerized microservices on Amazon EKS. User requests enter via Amazon CloudFront, which uses Lambda at the edge for device and region routing and Amazon S3 for static assets. Traffic routes through Application Load Balancers (~60 ALBs) that dynamically route between legacy monolithic systems on EC2 and microservices hosted on Amazon EKS (250+ services across 1400+ pods). The data layer comprises self-managed MongoDB and Apache Kafka on EC2, alongside relational Amazon RDS. Monitoring is handled via Amazon CloudWatch (pod health) and self-managed tools (Prometheus, ELK) on EC2.
nombre: Seera Group Microservices Migration and Travel Platform
